The Admin Web dictionary is a different 266-key catalog: only 7 of the 31 starter-template keys overlap, so do not silently merge the dictionaries or rename keys without a traceable mapping.
Customer/Driver/Admin Mobile manifests have no declared central i18n/localization dependency in the current source; Customer TopLanguage is interactive.
The Backend Prisma schema has no clear saved account locale field; inspect existing profile/preferences routes before creating a new endpoint or migration.
Public Website localization is not yet integrated.
